user.title: Set up water softener
user.description: Counts regenerations via the water meter and tracks the salt stock. A regeneration is detected when more water than the threshold is used within the time window.

data_description.water_entity: Sensor with the cumulative meter reading in a volume unit (L, m³, gal, ft³ …), e.g. from the energy dashboard.
data_description.capacity_kg: How many kilograms of salt fit into the brine tank?
data_description.per_regen_kg: How many kilograms of salt does one regeneration use?
data_description.initial_stock_kg: Optional. Leave empty if the tank is full right now.
data_description.threshold_l: A regeneration counts if more than this amount of water is used within the time window.
data_description.window_start_hour: Start of the time window in which the regeneration takes place (default 2 am).
data_description.window_end_hour: End of the time window (default 3 am). Must be after the start.
data_description.warn_remaining: From this calculated remaining stock on, a notice is shown until the refill is confirmed.

error.window_invalid: The end of the time window must be after its start.
error.per_regen_too_large: Salt per regeneration must not exceed the tank capacity.
error.stock_too_large: The current salt stock must not exceed the tank capacity.

data_description.water_entity: Sensor with the cumulative meter reading in a volume unit (L, m³, gal, ft³ …).
data_description.capacity_kg: How many kilograms of salt fit into the salt tank? A larger stock is limited to this value.
data_description.per_regen_kg: How many kilograms of salt does one regeneration use?
data_description.threshold_l: A regeneration counts if more than this amount of water is used within the time window.
data_description.window_start_hour: Start of the time window in local time (default 2 o'clock).
data_description.window_end_hour: End of the time window (default 3 o'clock). Must be after the start; evaluated one minute later.
data_description.warn_remaining: From this calculated remaining stock on, a notification appears until the refill is confirmed.

error.window_invalid: The end of the time window must be after its start.
error.per_regen_too_large: Salt per regeneration must not exceed the tank capacity.

refill.name: Salt refilled
refill.description: Confirms that salt was refilled. The amount in kg is required and is added to the stock (at most up to full). The notice ends once the stock is above the warning threshold again.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

kg.name: Amount refilled
kg.description: Amount in kg that was refilled (greater than 0).

set_salt_stock.name: Set salt stock
set_salt_stock.description: Sets the calculated salt stock to a specific value (e.g. after checking the tank). “Regenerations since refill” stays unchanged; both values are independent.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

add_regeneration.name: Add regeneration
add_regeneration.description: Adds an undetected regeneration manually (counters and salt stock are adjusted). Without a time, now is used; an older time does not move the last regeneration back.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

datetime.name: Time
datetime.description: Optional: when the regeneration took place (not in the future, without time zone local time). Default: now.

set_last_regeneration.name: Set last regeneration
set_last_regeneration.description: Sets the time of the last regeneration (e.g. from the softener's display). Determines “Next regeneration at the latest” and the “Regeneration overdue” notice. Counters and salt stock stay unchanged.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

datetime.name: Time
datetime.description: Date and time of the last regeneration (not in the future).

set_regenerations_since_refill.name: Set regenerations since refill
set_regenerations_since_refill.description: Sets the known regenerations since the last fill to full. The salt stock changes relative to it: by (previous count − new count) × salt per regeneration, limited to 0 to tank size. Confirming the same value again changes nothing.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

count.name: Count
count.description: Regenerations since the tank was last filled up.

unknown_unit.title: Unknown unit of the water meter
unknown_unit.description:
The water meter {entity} of the water softener “{name}” reports the unit “{unit}”. This is not a known volume unit (known are e.g. L, mL, m³, gal, ft³, CCF). As long as this is the case, the meter reading is not counted and no regeneration is detected.

Please set a volume unit on the sensor or choose another water meter in the integration settings. This notice disappears as soon as a value with a known unit arrives.

refill_amount_required.message: Please enter the refilled amount of salt in kg (greater than 0).

datetime_in_future.message: The time must not be in the future.

negative_count.message: The number of regenerations must not be negative.

no_entry.message: No water softener is set up.

multiple_entries.message: Several water softeners are set up: please specify the entry (config_entry).
